steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Vector graphics (Illustrator) use mathematical paths — they scale infinitely without quality loss; ideal for logos and illustrations. | Key Fact: Raster images (Photoshop) are pixel-based — they lose quality when enlarged; ideal for photo editing and digital painting. | Key Fact: Resolution matters: 72ppi for screen, 300ppi for print; RGB colour mode for screen, CMYK for print. | Key Fact: Layers, masks and non-destructive editing allow you to experiment without permanently altering your original image.
